title: Quality Assurance Executive
job_description:
1. 教育与经验 教育背景：通常要求拥有工程学（土木、机 械、电气）、理学（食品科技、化学、生物学）或质量管理专业的学士学位或文凭。 经验：大多数职位要求在质量保证/质量控制（QA/QC）环境中拥有2至5年的相关经验。 2. 技术技能与知识 标准：熟练掌握ISO FSSC 22000以及行业特定标准，如GMP、HACCP 或清真认证（食品行业），等等。 工具：了解7种QC工具（例如，鱼骨图、帕累托图）、统计过程控制（SPC）以及精益/六西格玛方法论。 软件：熟练使用MS Office进行数据分析和报告，通常还需要掌握ERP系统。 3. 关键软技能 注重细节：细致是识别规格偏差的关键。 分析性问题解决能力：能够解读数据趋势并深入调查缺陷。 沟通能力：具备良好的口头和书面沟通能力，能够与供应商、监管机构（如JAKIM或KKM）以及内部团队进行有效沟通。 1. Education & Experience Education: A Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical), Science (Food Tech, Chemistry, Biology), or Quality Management is typically required. Experience: Most roles require 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a QA/QC environment. 2. Technical Skills & Knowledge Standards: Proficiency in ISO FSSC 22000 , and industry-specific standards like GMP, HACCP, or Halal (for food) and ect. Tools: Knowledge of 7 QC Tools (e.g., Fishbone, Pareto charts), Statistical Process Control (SPC), and Lean/Six Sigma methodologies. Software: Competence in MS Office for data analysis and reporting, and often ERP systems. 3. Critical Soft Skills Attention to Detail: Meticulousness is vital for identifying deviations from specifications. Analytical Problem-Solving: Ability to interpret data trends and perform deep investigations into defects. Communication: Strong verbal and written skills to liaise with suppliers, regulatory bodies (like JAKIM or KKM), and internal teams.

流程管理 (QA): 开发和维护食品安全体系 (FSS)，包括手册、标准操作程序 (SOP) 和质量方针。 协调和进行内部和外部审核，以确保符合 FSSC 22000、ISO 22000、GMP、HACCP 或清真等标准。 管理纠正和预防措施 (CAPA) 和不合格报告 (NCR)，以解决问题的根本原因。 运营控制 (QC): 监督进厂原材料、过程生产和最终成品的检验。 使用卡尺和量规等工具进行感官评估、实验室测试或尺寸检查。 通过根本原因分析 (RCA) 调查客户投诉并实施解决方案。 文档与培训: 维护准确的质量记录、测试结果和供应商认证，以供审核追溯。 对员工进行质量标准、卫生规范和安全规程的培训。 Process Management (QA): Develop and maintain the Food Safety System (FSS) , including manuals, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and quality policies. Coordinate and conduct internal and external audits to ensure compliance with standards like FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, GMP, HACCP or Halal. Manage Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and non-conformance reports (NCR) to address root causes of issues. Operational Control (QC): Oversee inspections of incoming raw materials, in-process production, and final finished goods. Perform sensory evaluations, laboratory tests, or dimensional checks using tools like calipers and gauges. Investigate customer complaints through Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement solutions. Documentation & Training: Maintain accurate quality records, test results, and supplier certifications for audit traceability. Conduct staff training on quality standards, hygiene practices, and safety protocols.
